title: Reuse the same destination container for all objects in a multi-object task
description: Use when the task specifies a single destination for multiple items.
content: After placing the first object at the destination, return to the source to retrieve the next object and place it at the same destination. Verify the destination after each placement to confirm the previous object remains there.

title: Heat objects with a microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use when a task requires heating an object such as a plate.
content: To heat an object in a microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action. Heating will not work if the object is not inside the microwave or if the microwave is not properly prepared.

title: Locate target objects by searching multiple countertops
description: Use this when the required object is not visible on the first surface you check.
content: When searching for a specific object like a mug, check multiple countertops or surfaces in the environment. The object may be on a different countertop than the first one visited, so continue exploring nearby locations until the target object is found.

title: Search common furniture surfaces when looking for newspapers
description: Use this when searching for newspapers or similar reading materials in a living room environment.

description: Use when a task requires cooling an object that is currently hot or at room temperature.
content: Pick up the target object first, then go to a fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action. The fridge does not need to contain anything for the cooling action to succeed.

title: Use a microwave to heat objects when a stoveburner is occupied or unresponsive

content: To heat an object, first open the microwave, move the object into it, then use the heat action with the microwave while holding the object. Do not waste time repeatedly trying to move the object onto a stoveburner if the environment does not accept that action.

content: Before moving an item into a closed container, open the container first. Once the container is open, use the move action to place the item inside, and the container can remain open for subsequent items.
